# Tycodes

> Tycodes LLC is a South Florida tech partner run by Tylor. It helps local businesses in Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties get found by customers, handle their technology, and sell products online. The main call to action on every page is a free 15 minute audit call.

## Services

- [AI Visibility](https://tycodes.dev/ai-visibility): Setup and monthly care that helps customers find a business when they ask ChatGPT, Google and other AI tools for a recommendation. For trades and local service businesses. Starting at $400 per month, plus a one-time setup quoted on the call. No ranking or result is guaranteed.
- [Tech Partner](https://tycodes.dev/tech-partner): Software set up, AI tools for the office, and accounts and backups locked down, with ongoing monthly support. Starting at $250 per month.
- [3D Scroll Shop](https://tycodes.dev/3d-scroll-shop): A product page that moves as people scroll and leads straight into checkout. A one-time project for product brands. Starting at $1,500. Demos and a demo maker are at https://tycodes.app.

## Free website audit

- [Website audit tool](https://tycodes.dev/audit): Enter a website address to scan it and see what could be improved. No email is needed to see the results.
